mechanism: Diclofenac (NSAID) increases gastrointestinal bleeding risk and may reduce renal perfusion; nalmefene (opioid antagonist) has no direct pharmacokinetic interaction but combined use increases adverse event risk in patients with opioid co-administration.
action: Monitor for gastrointestinal bleeding and renal function; use lowest effective NSAID dose and consider gastroprotection (PPI); nalmefene alone with diclofenac requires careful monitoring if opioids are also present.
